description: Flex row that switches to a column once the switcher's own width drops below the threshold (a flex-basis formula, no media or container query). Attribute form: data-layout="switcher" (same modifiers).

attributes.name: data-layout-gap
attributes.description: Gap between items, on the shared size scale.

attributes.name: data-layout-threshold
attributes.description: The switcher's own width below which the row becomes a column: 25 / 30 / 40rem. No container query is involved. One-off: style="--layout-threshold: 35rem" (not inherited by nested switchers).

attributes.name: data-layout-limit
attributes.description: Force the column layout once there are more than this many items.

attributes.name: data-layout-reverse
attributes.description: Reverse the visual order when stacked (flex-wrap: wrap-reverse): the last item is on top once items wrap onto their own lines; the row keeps DOM order. Visual only — focus and reading order stay in DOM order, so use it only when the stacked order is presentational.
